title: On-call incident report (#53)
description: Written by the on-call agent; validated by the workflow before anything is posted. Identifiers, component names and code references only: no personal data, no supplier content, no secret.

summary.description: What users experienced and when, in two or three sentences.

suspected_cause.description: The most likely cause, naming the error type and the code location seen in the evidence.

evidence_trace_ids.description: Trace IDs, taken from the telemetry, that support the cause.

proposed_change.description: "none", or a short description of the change the agent made in the working tree (backend/ or frontend/ only), which the workflow turns into a pull request.
